decisions.reason: The cleaning soap gained its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment, and an accessory product that complements the core flooring offer costs little to keep.
The maintenance oil line stays on the website and fits the firm's surface-treatment offer, so keeping it open is cheap while its value is still being revealed.
The care product for oiled floors was promoted to a dedicated page, which indicates positive results that justify continued investment.
The moisture-protection underlay is a low-cost complement to floor sales with steady website presence, so there is no evidence that warrants abandoning it.
The high-density underlay overlaps somewhat with Product D, but holding both options is inexpensive while demand for each is still unclear.
The oak parquet line is close to the core business and remains listed, so it continues as a central part of the firm's assortment.
